channel.title: Daily Morning Briefing
channel.description: A personal daily news briefing, read aloud.
channel.itunes:author: Daily News Briefing

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 28 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: eight to fifteen degrees, partly cloudy, not a drop of rain. Look at the whole week: every rain figure is a zero. Six days, six zeros. The sky has filed for leave. Highs hover between fifteen and ten, a week with the personality of a beige cardigan. Only Friday…

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 21 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: seven to eleven degrees, thirty millimetres, wind up to eight metres a second. Fine. Now watch the staircase. Thursday fifty-four millimetres. Friday nearly seventy, wind ten, the top step, a number that belongs on a flood poster, not a forecast. Three days,…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 27 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: eight to fifteen degrees, five millimetres of rain, wind up to eight metres a second. That is the sky's final tantrum. Then, sit down, five dry days. Wednesday, nothing. Thursday, fog and a tenth of a millimetre, practically gossip. Friday, thirteen and cloudy.…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 20 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
No brief yesterday, so this covers two days. Today: nine to twelve degrees, twenty millimetres of rain, wind to five metres a second. Soaking. Wednesday is the main event: thirty-three and a half millimetres, wind to ten metres a second, rain arriving sideways, and…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 29 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: eight to fourteen, partly cloudy, dry, light wind. Tomorrow: eight to fourteen, partly cloudy, dry, light wind. Saturday: eight to fourteen, dry, light wind. That is not a forecast, that is a screensaver. Three days, one picture, and you will still check the app…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 22 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: eight to thirteen degrees, thirty-nine millimetres, wind up to six metres a second. The support act. Friday is the headliner: seventy-five millimetres, wind ten. Saturday is the encore, seventy millimetres, so nobody leaves early. That is nearly a hundred and…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 18 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: seven to fourteen degrees, sixteen and a half millimetres, wind to seven metres a second. Wet. Monday twelve. Tuesday forty-five millimetres at eleven to twelve degrees, a day too sulky to change temperature. Wednesday and Thursday a drizzly three and four.…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 31 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: seven to fourteen, partly cloudy, dry, light wind. After the wettest week in two years, the sky has gone teetotal. Sunday it relapses: six to ten, cloudy, two millimetres, one sad drink. Then Monday seven to twelve, dry and windier, Tuesday and Wednesday dry,…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 17 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: six to thirteen degrees, fair, four tenths of a millimetre. Fine. Enjoy it, you ungrateful lump. Sunday is the problem: thirty point two millimetres, seven to twelve degrees. That is more than Monday to Thursday put together, which total about eleven.…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 30 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: nine to fourteen, partly cloudy, dry, light wind. Saturday: eight to fourteen, dry, so the kids go out begging sugar and you hand over the cheap stuff. Sunday drops to seven to ten, cloudy, one millimetre of rain. That is the day someone in your house says put…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 23 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: seven to twelve degrees, twenty-one millimetres, wind up to eleven metres a second. A named storm is here and another is queuing behind it. But Saturday is the main event: one hundred and twenty-six millimetres, the wettest day forecast this month. Cancel…
